outOfScope: Jev provider/verdict semantics or the atomic-choice policy.
Candidate/evidence/merge binding or DELIVERED_FEATURE receipt semantics.
constraints: Preserve the two lanes RESEARCH_SA and WORKER, phase semantics, one-task claim ownership, direct task dependency ordering, exact objective/plan bindings, independent Jev judgment, negative-case binding, Living Docs consolidation and exact candidate/evidence/merge delivery verification.
Do not change Jev verdict semantics, provider policy, worker evidence retention, OBJECTIVE_SUPERSESSION semantics or delivery receipt semantics in this cleanup.

Do not remove a field or layer merely because it is aesthetically redundant; removal requires either no current consumer, a derivable equivalent, or a replacement that preserves the same decision/authority value.
Migrate current unfinished tasks deterministically and preserve terminal receipts/artifacts without rewriting historical evidence.
Fresh-agent onboarding must not regress: the post-cleanup bootstrap must recover the exact task, lane/phase, current-system refs, plan scope and legal next action without prior conversation.
invariants: Task remains the only scheduling/claim/execution unit and direct dependency ordering remains acyclic and fail-closed.
RESEARCH_SA and WORKER remain the only lanes; phases and exact objective/plan/Jev/delivery authority remain unchanged.
Removing derived context/state files cannot remove semantic continuation state; bootstrap must derive the same current obligation from canonical data.
DONE dependency context still resolves to consolidated Living truth, never terminal implementation transcript by default.
Plan sourceScope remains the only product-source mutation authority for contracted work; component metadata cannot widen it.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Remove the Feature layer from the current graph. Current evidence is 79 Features / 79 Tasks with every Feature owning exactly one Task and acceptanceTaskId equal to that sole Task. Migrate each task to direct topicId; union the former Feature artifactRefs into that Task's artifacts.inputRefs; remove graph.features, topic.featureIds, task.featureId, feature status and acceptanceTaskId. Topic stays as the roadmap grouping boundary.

D2 — Collapse dependency edges to direct task identity only. Current evidence is 152 edges: 151 use requires=['TASK_OUTPUT']; the lone DELIVERED_SYSTEM_TRUTH edge is legacy BB-052 -> BB-048 and is already represented by the delivered dependency rule. Store dependencies as task ids (or taskId-only objects) and keep the existing rule: RESEARCH may inspect unfinished dependency objective/plan; WORKER requires DONE; DONE contributes consolidatedRefs.

D3 — Remove graph fields with no contracted-path decision consumer: task.complexity, task.kind, task.expectedOutputs, topic.status, and allocation.executionUnit/contextRoutingUnit/workerOwnership. Keep allocation.nextWorkId. Objective/READY plan own outcome and executable acceptance semantics; lane/phase/status own lifecycle.

D4 — Remove persisted helper context identity. Delete task.currentContextRef and docs/blackboard/context/<id>/current.json as lifecycle state. Keep task.claim.workerId for single-owner concurrency. deriveTaskContext becomes the only semantic context constructor and bootstrap derives/materializes it on demand for the exact task/phase. No context file write/delete is needed on claim, judgment or delivery.

D5 — Keep the human routing projection but stop committing it. blackboard-state-project.mjs renders the current summary on demand from graph/registry; remove docs/blackboard/state.md as a tracked source and remove verify-state drift checks. AGENTS/docs instruct fresh sessions to run/read the generated view, then resolve the exact task.

D6 — Slim Component Registry to fields with current contracted-path value. Keep component id, currentSystemRefs and bounded progressiveSearchRoots; keep contractRefs only as explicit discovery hints. Remove contextOwner (validation-only) and sourceRoots/testRoots (legacy resolver-only); READY plan sourceScope remains mutation/read authority.

D7 — Retire legacy outer-context machinery after proving no unfinished consumer: delete blackboard-context-board.mjs, blackboard-context-generate.mjs and their legacy-only tests; remove the non-OBJECTIVE_PLAN_DELIVERY branch in context contract/resolver/verify; remove migrate:blackboard-delivery and blackboard-delivery-migrate.mjs. The retained legacy terminal task remains historical data, not a runtime compatibility requirement.

D8 — Replace the current synthetic eval:blackboard-context value claim. Its artifact declares productionEvidence=false and its reduction baseline is constructed by adding repository-scan/history/guess refs. Keep deterministic context invariants as tests, but do not call them a value gate. Add a focused before/after fresh-bootstrap fixture proving identical task selection, dependency truth, current-system refs, source scope and phase obligation with fewer persisted/schema fields.

D9 — Do not simplify Jev or terminal evidence retention in this task. The recent BB-152 readiness run demonstrated real independent-judge value by returning RESEARCH_REQUIRED for an underspecified plan; exact candidate/evidence/merge checks and retained incident evidence remain value-bearing until separately benchmarked.
implementationSlices: S1 — Graph kernel: migrate Feature -> direct Topic/Task, simplify dependency edge shape, remove unused task/topic/allocation metadata, and update graph validation/supersession identity preservation without changing lane/phase/status/claim/contract authority.

S2 — Derived context removal: eliminate currentContextRef/current.json lifecycle writes and verification; derive task context on demand from canonical graph/plan/registry in claim/bootstrap/judgment/finalization paths.
S3 — Registry + legacy retirement: slim Component Registry fields and delete legacy context-generation/board-parsing/migration compatibility code proven unreachable by unfinished contracted work.
S4 — Projection/docs: stop tracking state.md, retain on-demand renderer, update AGENTS/README/contracts to point at generated routing view and canonical sources.

S5 — Value regression: add one focused parity suite over representative RESEARCH, EXECUTION, JUDGMENT/MERGE_PENDING and DONE-dependency cases; prove same scheduling/authority/context semantics with smaller schema and no persisted helper context.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Canonical graph uses Topic -> Task directly and removes one-to-one Feature/acceptance duplication, constant dependency-requires metadata and unused task/topic/allocation fields without changing schedulability, direct dependency ordering or task identity.
evidenceRequired: Before/after fixture covering all current tasks/dependency edges with identical task readiness results and preserved planning refs.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Fresh bootstrap and context materialization require no persisted current.json/currentContextRef; claim ownership stays explicit and exact phase/source authority is derived from canonical data.
evidenceRequired: Fixtures for RESEARCH, EXECUTION and read-only finalization proving no helper-context file exists or is written while returned context remains deterministic.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Component Registry and outer-context runtime contain only fields/code with a current contracted consumer; legacy compatibility scripts/branches are absent and no unfinished task depends on them.
evidenceRequired: Consumer inventory plus fixture showing every unfinished task derives context through OBJECTIVE_PLAN_DELIVERY.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Cleanup reduces schema/projection/runtime surface while preserving task selection, dependency truth, current-system refs, plan source scope, Jev authority and delivery binding; synthetic context checks are no longer presented as production value evidence.
evidenceRequired: Counted before/after fields/files plus semantic parity assertions and full repository verification.

negativeVerificationCases: Graph simplification drops a Feature planning ref or changes any current task's derived readiness/dependency result.
Fresh bootstrap silently recreates or requires current.json/currentContextRef, or a read-only phase gains product-source write authority.
Registry/legacy cleanup widens source mutation authority beyond the exact READY plan or leaves an unfinished task on a removed legacy path.
